findings.desc: DONE-required timeout classification is not implemented across the promised layers. `runDoneRequiredValidation` records a command timeout as a FAIL receipt, but `handlers/done-required-validation.ts` maps every non-PASS to result=failed and always emits timeoutLayer=null; `done_prepare` then parses that as failed and omits timeoutLayer. The CLI idle/max watchdog in `cli-engine.ts` still calls process.exit(2), so direct/done_prepare JSON receives no terminal result at all for idle/max expiry. Even successful done_prepare reused/executed output omits timeoutLayer=null because `donePrepareJsonResult` only adds a recognized non-null token. This contradicts CHK-001/003 requirements for result=timed_out and timeoutLayer=command|phase|idle|max, and leaves the JSON contract unable to distinguish timeout from validation failure.
findings.resolvedReason: Repro: real subprocess matrices force command, phase, CLI idle, and CLI max expiry and inspect JSON plus shell status. Root cause: command receipts collapsed timeout into generic failure, done_prepare omitted routine watchdog attribution, and cli-engine force-exited before handlers could settle. Fix: timeout receipts now map to result=timed_out/timeoutLayer=command; AbortController-backed structured watchdogs propagate idle|max to direct validation and done_prepare; phase remains phase-attributed; structured failed/timed_out/blocked output stays parseable and exits nonzero. ReproTest: npm --prefix packages/main run build; node packages/main/dist/tasks/validate-progress-heartbeat-smoke.js; node packages/main/dist/tasks/done-prepare-closure-heartbeat-smoke.js. Both smoke commands PASS at HEAD a6cefb0 and assert nonzero timeout status plus immediate rerun cleanup.

findings.desc: The trusted metadata-only reuse lineage checks only the net tree diff (`git diff --name-only evidenceHead..currentHead`), not paths touched by every intervening commit. A descendant history can modify a code/config path and later restore it; that path disappears from the net diff, so this function can classify the lineage as trusted-story-metadata-descendant. This violates the documented and CHK-002 requirement that every intervening changed path be trusted metadata and that any intervening code/config path refuse reuse. Enumerate changed paths per commit across the ancestry range (including deletes/renames) or explicitly narrow the contract to final-tree equivalence.
findings.resolvedReason: Repro: create evidence at an ancestor, modify a non-metadata path in one intervening commit, restore it in a later commit, then evaluate reuse; the former net diff hid the touched path. Root cause: lineage trust used only git diff evidenceHead..currentHead instead of enumerating paths touched by every commit. Fix: reuse now verifies ancestry, enumerates rev-list commits, reads each commit with diff-tree --no-renames, rejects any untrusted touched path including modify-then-revert and rename history, and rechecks HEAD to close TOCTOU. ReproTest: node packages/main/dist/tasks/done-required-validation-smoke.js; node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs. Both PASS at HEAD a6cefb0 and mechanically cover per-commit lineage, non-ancestor, code/config paths, modify-revert, rename, and concurrent HEAD movement.

findings.desc: All 28 must intents are marked covered by four smoke commands, but the assertions exercise only a small subset. Budget tests use one 1,200,000ms command: no 290,000+1,200,000 sequence, default-timeout command, malformed/non-positive inputs, unrelated CLI max, LATTICE_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS, or phase/max race; phase-timeout JSON does not assert disposition/result/refusalReasons/timeoutLayer. Reuse tests call the evaluator only and never exercise done_prepare default reuse, reuseFreshDoneRequired=false, fresh/stale/missing validate=false immutability, structured failure/timeout/block outputs, malformed/unreadable evidence, full lineage matrix, or TOCTOU. Direct-handler tests run an instant child and synchronous throwing sink only: no silent heartbeat past idle, real direct CLI watchdog, explicit idle/max, passing and failing rejected sinks, boundary ordering, descendant cleanup, lock reacquisition, or late-heartbeat race. Add table-driven budget tests and hermetic real-CLI fixtures per omitted intent, then bind each evidence ref to assertions that actually exist.
findings.resolvedReason: Repro: compare all 28 must intent descriptions with their former smoke assertions; budget, reuse, malformed evidence, real CLI watchdog, process-tree cleanup, and sink rejection paths were absent. Root cause: broad command-level evidence was recorded without assertion-specific coverage. Fix: added table-driven arithmetic and override tests, real runValidationCommand overflow/fallback tests, actual done_prepare reuse/validate=false matrices, malformed evidence recovery, per-commit lineage and TOCTOU tests, real direct command/idle/max and routine done_prepare idle/max subprocesses, descendant kill plus immediate rerun, and sync/async progress-sink containment. ReproTest: node packages/main/dist/tasks/done-required-validation-smoke.js; node packages/main/dist/tasks/done-prepare-closure-heartbeat-smoke.js; node packages/main/dist/tasks/validate-progress-heartbeat-smoke.js; node packages/main/dist/tasks/command-catalog-smoke.js; node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs. All PASS at HEAD a6cefb0; checklist evidence is assertion-specific and complete at 9/9, 10/10, 9/9.

findings.desc: Malformed or unreadable existing done-required evidence aborts the recovery path instead of being classified stale and replaced. evaluateDoneRequiredPreRunReuse calls evaluateDoneRequiredEvidence without a containment boundary (done-prepare-validation-reuse.ts:97), while StoryStore deliberately rethrows JSON parse/read errors for this artifact (store.ts:236-241). Both direct done_required_validate (done-required-validation.ts:46) and done_prepare validate=false/validate=true invoke that evaluator before they can execute or report structured status. A truncated JSON file therefore throws out of the command; even a valid JSON object with missing arrays can trigger TypeErrors in the canonical evaluator. This violates the fail-closed-but-convergent contract: malformed evidence must yield existingEvidenceBasis=stale with a refusal reason, validate=false must remain observation-only, and validate=true/direct validation must be able to run once and overwrite bad evidence. Catch artifact/evaluator shape/read failures in the pre-run reuse wrapper, return reusable=false/stale with a stable malformed-or-unreadable reason, and ensure execution does not depend on parsing prior evidence.
findings.resolvedReason: Repro: replace done-required-evidence.json with truncated JSON and then with a valid object missing required arrays; invoke validate=false observation and validate=true/direct execution. Root cause: evaluateDoneRequiredPreRunReuse allowed store read/parse and canonical evaluator shape exceptions to escape before execution. Fix: the reuse wrapper contains unreadable/malformed artifact and evaluator failures, returns reusable=false with existingEvidenceBasis=stale and stable evidence-malformed-or-unreadable refusal, while validate=false remains non-mutating and validate=true/direct validation overwrite bad evidence with a fresh receipt. ReproTest: node packages/main/dist/tasks/done-required-validation-smoke.js; node packages/main/dist/tasks/done-prepare-closure-heartbeat-smoke.js. Both PASS at HEAD a6cefb0 and assert malformed JSON/shape classification, byte-for-byte validate=false immutability, and successful recovery execution.

findings.desc: F-001 remains incomplete for done_prepare CLI idle/max timeouts. cli-engine now aborts a signal instead of exiting, but done_prepare only threads that parent signal into routine verifier.validate and the DONE-required runCloseoutPhase. The later doneClosure/reviewAssurance/runtimeChange/cleanTree/produceCommand runCloseoutPhase calls do not receive rawArgs.abortSignal, so an explicit max expiry during those phases is logged but does not terminate or structure the result. Even inside DONE-required validation, a parent CliWatchdogTimeoutError is not a DonePreparePhaseTimeoutError, so the catch falls through to `result=blocked` without timeoutLayer instead of `result=timed_out` with idle|max. The watchdog also has no top-level Promise.race fallback, so any uncooperative/synchronous done_prepare segment can outlive the absolute max. Thread/race the CLI watchdog across the whole handler and classify its reason before the generic blocked path; verify nonzero JSON outcomes for idle and max in both routine and post-validation closeout phases.

The additive done_prepare JSON defaults misclassify any transcript that blocks before validation. `donePrepareJsonResult` now fills missing fields with disposition=skipped_explicitly, result=blocked/not_run, existingEvidenceBasis=missing, but `skipped_explicitly` is contractually reserved for validate=false. A merge/preflight/stale-evidence blocker did not explicitly skip validation and its existing evidence basis was never evaluated, so the emitted structure asserts false facts. Preserve nullable/not_applicable fields for pre-validation blockers, or evaluate and emit a distinct disposition that does not claim an explicit operator skip.

Round-2 smokes pass, but the 28 must refs are still not assertion-specific and several safety cases remain unproved. The CHK-002 evidence map is shifted: happy:1 points to reuse-disabled execution (the edge:0 requirement), edge:0 points to validate=false (edge:1), edge:1 to canonical mutations (adversarial:0), edge:2 to lineage, edge:3 to malformed evidence, and adversarial:2 to generic output fields. More importantly, done-prepare-closure-heartbeat-smoke.ts:326-345 does not exercise actual exact-HEAD versus trusted-descendant reuse separately; reuse disabled only asserts a progress line, not disposition=executed or evidence refresh. done-required-validation-smoke.ts:429-655 lacks independent evidence-schema mutation, proof-admissibility failure mutation, non-ancestor HEAD, and metadata-like-outside-allowlist cases required by CHK-002 adversarial:0/2. The timeout matrices at validate-progress-heartbeat-smoke.ts:277-399 use wide timing margins rather than just-before/just-after command/phase/idle/max races; descendant ESRCH is asserted only for command timeout, while CHK-003 adversarial:0 requires descendant-tree termination separately for command, phase, idle, and max. No test emits heartbeat concurrently with abort/exit/error or asserts no post-terminal heartbeat/duplicate evidence. Add the missing matrix rows/race instrumentation, assert disabled-reuse terminal fields and refreshed receipt, and remap each verificationEvidence intentRef to its actual assertion before accepting coverage.
